DGP.AR: phi stationary AR1; Gaussian or standardized t5 innovations; unit variance initialization, 128 burn points
DGP.analytic_population_truth: E_time Z^2=1 and E_seed A=base, so theta_j=base_j-base_candidate exactly; never estimate truth from a generated sample
DGP.seed_pairing: same seed identifiers for all20 systems; seed effects correlated through common component; temporal factors shared as specified
DGP.scope: controlled synthetic error process with known truth, not a fitted market DGP or a new predictor

algorithms.bootstrap_statistic: full mean of individual seed RMSEs, crossed resampling of whole matched seed rows and common stationary temporal indices
algorithms.bootstrap_CI: basic 95% two-sided and one-sided95% lower endpoint from centered full-functional roots
algorithms.P2_variance: between-seed variance/S plus HAC temporal influence-of-seed-average/T; explicitly conservative double count of nonnegative interaction in additive crossed-effects linearization; report interaction estimator and corrected diagnostic separately
algorithms.P2_HLN: h1 factor sqrt((T-1)/T) only multiplies the t statistic, and corresponding inversion uses conservative widened SE; this is not proof classical DM-HLN validity for crossed RMSE
algorithms.P2_reference_df: S-1 conservative reference, needs empirical/methodological review
algorithms.MCS: T_R range statistic and elimination with monotone model-exclusion p-values, full-functional crossed bootstrap; global EPA not a pairwise practical-margin test
algorithms.near_zero_MSE: non-differentiable or unsupported inference rejected; exact equal zero-variance contrasts conservatively nonreject
algorithms.formal_scope: extensions remain proposed until assumptions and admissibility accepted; simulations do not establish universal validity

families.executed_software_validation_family: 2 directional methods x19 rivals =38 rawp; Holm38 is a separate controlled-validation diagnostic, not the old proposed57 primary family
families.reserved_57_slot_diagnostic: also Holm with19 unimplemented p=1 slots, explicitly labeled reservation-only; no actual third method or complete three-way power inferred
families.never_report: MCS exclusion as directional p(theta_j<=delta) or third component

Monte_Carlo.checkpoint: JSONL after every replicate; resource stop preserves partial outcome without new seeds/retries for favorable result
Monte_Carlo.binomial_precision: individual central95% Clopper-Pearson for per-rival size/coverage and Bernoulli family events; do not pool correlated rivals as extra MC replicates
Monte_Carlo.screens: inflation detected if lower95%CP>nominal; exploratory tolerance screening upper95%CP<=nominal+.05; otherwise inconclusive. No final calibration approval from bounded MC. Coverage deficit detected if upper95%CP<.95.
Monte_Carlo.R_T_scaling: report empirical SD and mean estimated components at12x128,24x128,12x256; no fitted variance or finalR/T supplied
